claims.confidence: high for rule; medium for commercial timing
claims.statement: From 2030, covered operators must ensure at least 40% of specified transport packaging is reusable within a reuse system, creating a future need for pooled assets, tracking and reverse logistics.
Manufacturers, distributors and logistics operators face packaging redesign and reuse obligations, but their willingness to rent a regional pool rather than build one is unverified.

commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Local closed-loop density and verified return performance; pallet and packaging incumbents can replicate
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business through shipper rental contracts

fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Monthly rental and loss billing; asset purchases precede revenue
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 30-50% after wash, repair, repositioning and losses
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Depot labor, collection, washing, repair and account operations
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Warehouse, insurance, hygiene procedures, tracking system and legal contracts
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Per-trip rental, service fee and loss charge
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Packaging depreciation, transport, washing, repair and shrinkage

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Pallet-pool, packaging and 3PL incumbents extend reusable offerings
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Per shipment requiring reusable transport packaging, or avoided noncompliance and one-way-packaging cost
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: 2030 reuse-plan procurement or a high-volume closed logistics lane
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Monthly shipment volume and multi-year lane contract

contrary_evidence: A 100,000 PLN founder budget permits only a narrow pilot pool.
Reverse logistics can erase margins outside dense closed loops.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: No assets currently held; proposed purchase of standardized containers and customer rental agreements
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Operate tracking software for customer-owned packaging or target another closed loop
critical_control_point.current_owner: Packaging suppliers and shippers currently own assets and logistics relationships
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business through shipper rental contracts
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: No present packaging assets or shipper contracts
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Prospective business after purchasing assets and signing a closed-loop customer
critical_control_point.subject: Trackable reusable transport-packaging pool on dense regional lanes

economics.acquisition_route: Pre-sell one closed-loop lane, purchase a 200-500 unit pilot pool, outsource washing and transport, then reinvest utilization cash
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: reinvest to 80,000 assets generating 100 PLN annual contribution each by years 8-12; 8m PLN contribution before overhead could support 5m+ founder equity. Asset utilization, loss and financing remain major unknowns.
economics.founder_time: 15-25 hours weekly initially; depot and logistics must be outsourced
economics.gross_margin_basis: Rental and service revenue less depreciation, reverse logistics, wash, repair and shrinkage
economics.payback: Assumption: 24-36 months per container pool at high utilization
economics.pricing: Assumption: 3-12 PLN per trip plus cleaning and loss charges

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Regional asset density, return history and lane-level loss data
fingerprint.customer: CEE manufacturers and distributors with repeat closed-loop shipments
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Rental pool of tracked reusable transport packaging
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Shipper pays per completed packaging cycle
fingerprint.problem_trigger: 2030 reuse targets require physical pools and reverse logistics

founder_fit: Quantitative routing and loss prediction fit.
Can pilot near Ostrów with outsourced physical work.
Asset intensity tests the upper edge of available capital.

structure.control_point: Owned reusable-container density on contracted lanes
structure.critical_dependency: High return rates and outsourced reverse logistics

thesis: Future state: regional supply chains meet 2030 reuse targets through circulating packaging rather than disposable units. The missing physical mechanism is a dense, tracked pool with washing, repair and return logistics.
title: Regional Reusable-Transport-Packaging Pool
